Leclerc Grid Penalty Confirmed
**Source: crash.net, planetf1.com, gpblog.com, grandprix.com (Sept. 22-23, 2026)**
- Penalty confirmed: Leclerc will start from back of grid at Baku
- Plan: old Monza-damaged engine in FP1 Thursday (Sept. 24), new spec power unit for rest of weekend
- New engine spec: ~0.2 sec/lap faster than ADUO1 unit used in Spain
- Baku chosen because: 2.2 km main straight + heavy braking Turn 1 = best overtaking circuit remaining
- Vasseur quote (earlier): Baku "quite suitable" for grid drop
- Leclerc quote (earlier): penalty "probably" coming
- FP1 schedule: Thursday, September 24
- Qualifying: Friday, September 25
- Race: Saturday, September 26
- Confidence: HIGH (multiple sources confirm penalty strategy)

research.facts:
2026 Regulations at Baku
**Source: grandprix247.com, planetf1.com (Sept. 22-23, 2026)**
- 2026 F1 regs: lower downforce generation vs. 2025 era cars
- Baku impact: T18-T19 sequence — where 2025 cars could run flat, 2026 cars may need to lift
- Main straight: 2.2 km, speeds reaching ~340 kph
- MGU-K activation: longest delay of the season at Baku due to extended straight before push lap
- Energy management: teams deploying maximum power all through straight — critical to manage
- Circuit length: 6.003 km
- Lap count: 51 laps
- Race format: race on Saturday (unusual — moved for Azerbaijan Day of Remembrance Sept. 27)
- Confidence: HIGH
